title: A Note About Git Commit Messages
author: Tim Pope
version: 2008-04-19; the address is the publisher's and was not fetched in this container

record.source: A subject of 50 characters or less, a blank line, then the body wrapped at 72 columns.
record.kept: The 50 and the 72, which are the convention's subject budget.
record.rewritten: 72 is the body's wrap width in the note; this repository uses it as the subject ceiling, because the display line carries the short sha, and bounds the body at 280 characters instead.
record.added: The reading of 72 as a ceiling, and the policy layer over the numbers that the note does not state.
record.dropped: The body-wrap rule as such, and the advice to amend with `git commit --amend` as the only fold.
